newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Phoenix, Ariz..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Phoenix, Ariz..

text.p: Various Purpose General Obligation Bonds, Series 1997
Sealed proposals will be received by the City of Phoenix, State of Arizona, at the office of the Finance Director thereof located at 251 West Washington Street, Room 910, Phoenix, Arizona 85003, on

at the hour of 10:00 A.M., M.S.T., for the purchase on an all or none basis of its Various Purpose General Obligation Bonds, Series 1997, of the City of Phoenix. Said bonds are to be dated January 15, 1997, will bear interest payable on January 1 and July 1 of each year, commencing July 1, 1995, as shown in the Official Notice of Bond Sale. The sale of the bonds may be postponed by the Finance Director of the City depending upon market conditions. The principal amount of bonds to be sold will not exceed $32,000,000. The City will provide notice of any

postponement and other details of the sale through Munifacts or other reasonable means. The legal opinion of Chapman and Cutler, Phoenix, Arizona, will be printed on the bonds. Copies of the Official Notice of Bond Sale and Proposal for Purchase, and of the Official Statement relating to the bonds and of the ordinance adopted by the Mayor and City Council relating to the sale of these bonds will be furnished to any bidder upon request made to Mr. Kevin Keogh, Finance Director, at the address set forth above, telephone number (602)262-7166.
